scope: Complete public landing page for an electromecánico workshop and replacement-parts shop
audience: People and businesses in Argentina seeking workshop services or parts
job: Understand the offer, ask a question, request a quote, or pay for a published product
proof: Real workshop details, images, catalog and testimonials will be supplied by the owner; leave these empty or clearly marked as pending
constraints: Red and black; responsive; editable PostgreSQL content; Mercado Pago Checkout Pro; verified webhook updates; no invented business facts or prices

direction_contract.THESIS: A workshop landing page organized around the visitor's next practical decision: contact the shop, understand the repair offer, or ask about a part.
direction_contract.OWN-WORLD: Use a near-black workshop frame with decisive red action surfaces, warm neutral text, measured technical linework, restrained square geometry, and clear controls. The logo and photographic bays remain owner-replaceable.
direction_contract.STORY: The visitor first sees a concise workshop introduction and contact actions, then scans services and parts, learns about the shop, resolves common questions, and sends a message or checks out through Mercado Pago.
direction_contract.FIRST VIEWPORT: A compact dark navigation anchors a two-column hero: strong Spanish headline and quote/WhatsApp actions on the left, an intentionally labeled photo placeholder with red technical framing on the right. The workshop name remains an editable pending value.
direction_contract.FORM: Code-led single-page landing with server-backed content, payment creation and a distinct verified notification route.
direction_contract.FINISH: unreviewed and undocumented is unfinished; this build ends with the finish review, the verdict, DESIGN.md, and every shipping raster carrying its provenance
